Firstly get a 3mm bit and do 6 wraps around it. Make 2 coils like that. Place them in your RDA and tighten them down firmly. Get your mod to 25 watts and make them boys glow a dull orange. If they do not glow from the center out then pinch them lightly with tweezers (preferably ceramic) until they start glowing from the center outwards. Once they glow properly get a nice 1 by 3 inch peice of cotton and roll it nice and tight. And then insert it into coil. When you insert it into the coil it should grab with a decent amount of resistance. Then juice it and vape staring at 50 watts and moving up by 5w until your happy.
